notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 857). Steam app 976730 ("Halo: The Master Chief Collection") is the collection itself and was used; it has 700 achievements, none hidden. 613 of the 700 descriptions start with the game they belong to ("Halo CE:", "Halo 2:", "Halo 3:", "H3: ODST:", "Halo: Reach:", "Halo 4:", or "Halo 2A MP:", which the descriptions tie to Halo 2 Anniversary multiplayer), so the chapters follow those prefixes; chapter titles use the StrategyWiki page names the collection links (Halo: Combat Evolved, Halo 2, Halo 3, Halo 3: ODST, Halo: Reach, Halo 4). Spartan Ops (Halo 4) gets its own chapter. Achievements that mention multiplayer, matchmaking or matchmade games, Forge or custom games go to the multiplayer chapter even when they carry a game prefix (one Halo 3 skull description says "multilayer map", a typo in the Steam data, and is caught too), while Reach's Firefight ones stay in the Reach chapter. The 87 achievements with no game prefix are collection-wide and sit in the last chapter unless they name multiplayer or matchmade games; "missions or multiplayer games" counts stay collection-wide. The Steam store list also has Mod Tools apps for each game; they were not used. StrategyWiki has "Halo: The Master Chief Collection" at completion stage 1, marked as a stub, with no subpages, so it was not used. halo.fandom.com answers the API under "Halo: The Master Chief Collection" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
